purpose: Truth-free raw Android Cn0DbHz pseudorange code-tracking/multipath residual calibration audit on four route-disjoint Pixel5 recordings. The candidate is explicitly nonduplicate with the Phase47 integrity-no-go output, the existing adapter masks, and the optional upstream p85 SNR path.

objective.factor: raw Android Cn0DbHz pseudorange code-tracking/multipath residual calibration

phase43_champion.use: configuration and policy metadata only; no previous metric or coordinate payload is an audit input

phase47_policy_bug.use: integrity/no-go policy metadata only; Phase47 metric output is not read or reused

phase60_policy.use: sole-next-factor policy metadata only; Phase60 metrics are not an audit input

phase13_upstream_quality_policy.use: source policy and nonduplication pin only; no fixed threshold or truth-tuned selection is reproduced

adapter_masks.code_mask: MultipathIndicator==1 OR Cn0DbHz<20 OR invalid Android code/transmit State OR raw P outside [1e7,4e7] m
adapter_masks.cmc_adr_mask: AccumulatedDeltaRangeState VALID bit required; reset/slip bits break an arc
adapter_masks.transition_continuity: same supported system/SVID/signal, 0 < dt <= 1.5 s, unchanged HCDC and raw-clock segment, finite P and signed ADR

fixed_observable.raw_pseudorange: Phase25 integer/Decimal Android-clock reconstruction only; no RawPseudorangeMeters, WLS, SvPosition, SvElevation, navigation, coordinates, IMU, or truth
fixed_observable.carrier_sign: For Pixel5, preserve the signed AccumulatedDeltaRangeMeters because the adapter's published device sign-negation list does not include pixel5
fixed_observable.arc_centering: For each (system,SVID,signal,continuous ADR arc), subtract the finite arc median from CMC. This removes carrier ambiguity and persistent arc offset; no fitted geometry or receiver coordinate is used.
fixed_observable.singleton_arc_policy: A continuous valid arc must contain at least two rows for CMC residual eligibility; singleton rows are reported as warm-up/coverage exclusions and are not imputed.
fixed_observable.same_epoch_common_mode_diagnostic: Within each endpoint utcTimeMillis/HCDC group, report the median and centered CMC residuals separately; no common-mode estimate is applied as a correction.
fixed_observable.alpha_fit: alpha_m = median(abs(centered CMC_m) / shape(Cn0DbHz)) over the finite eligible training rows in each fixed three-route LOO fold; no truth, sweep, clip, or post-read tuning
fixed_observable.candidate_floor_if_authorized: sigma_final_m = max(existing_pseudorange_sigma_m, sigma_model_m); coefficient=1, no upper cap, FGO undifferenced pseudorange factors only; no SPP, TDCP, Doppler, or correction during audit
fixed_observable.impact_proxy: Because raw-only audit cannot read navigation/elevation, compare sigma_model_m to the frozen Phase43 configured base sigma 3.0 m. This is a conservative lower-bound proxy for actual factor impact; it is reported separately and is not called an effective elevation-scaled factor fraction.
fixed_observable.control: Existing Phase43 configured pseudorange sigma and existing adapter masks; no p85 path reproduction, correction, or data-selected threshold

cn0_bins.ordering: Lower Cn0 must not have lower centered-CMC median or p95; exact equality is allowed
cn0_bins.missing_or_below_20: reported separately and excluded from the candidate relation because existing masks already reject Cn0<20

numeric_gates.logic: AND; every threshold, formula, mask, field rule, and route order is immutable after this freeze and before the first Phase61 raw read

controls_and_repeats.primary: raw CMC arc-centered residual versus Cn0 model
controls_and_repeats.existing_mask_control: retain only rows passing the existing code/Cn0/multipath/state masks; report raw and post-mask populations; do not add a new mask
controls_and_repeats.p85_control: report that Phase43 p85 SNR route is disabled and do not reproduce its scale/factor
controls_and_repeats.route_loo: fit alpha on three in-memory route reports and evaluate the held route; no second raw read
controls_and_repeats.opposite_or_alternative_shape: none; source 20-dB shape and coefficient-one model are fixed before reading
controls_and_repeats.repeat_policy: one raw read per route in one process; deterministic summaries and exact presentation invariants are checked from that parse

failure_policy.any_gate_failure: fail closed, preserve exact raw/read/hash accounting, do not implement or rerun, and name exactly one next source-supported raw physical factor
failure_policy.missing_or_ambiguous_fields: hard no-go for correction; report header/finite availability without imputation
failure_policy.source_sign: fixed adapter Pixel5 ADR sign policy; never selected from route data
failure_policy.p85_nonduplication: do not mutate or reproduce the existing optional p85 SNR path
failure_policy.if_all_gates_pass: freeze a separate native implementation contract, then implement only the coefficient-one FGO pseudorange sigma floor, run focused tests/build and truth-free structural matrix, and stop before accuracy truth
failure_policy.next_single_factor_if_no_go: raw Android pseudorange code tracking / multipath residual calibration with a source-supported Cn0 model remains the factor under audit; if this audit fails, preserve Phase43 champion and do not select a second factor in Phase61
